# LLM Prefill & Decode Speed Visualizer

> Interactive visualizer and open JSON API for LLM inference performance: prefill vs decode latency (TTFT/TPOT), KV-cache VRAM fitting from a Hugging Face id alone, community-measured hardware benchmarks, and multi-turn agentic loop cost modeling. No auth, CORS-enabled, deterministic result ids, everything also described by an OpenAPI spec.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): features, setup and architecture overview
- [Full API guide (llms.txt)](https://llm-prefill-decode-visualizer.vercel.app/llms.txt): every endpoint with parameters, curl examples, response shapes, statistical caveats, error codes and rate limits
- [API changelog](CHANGELOG-API.md): schema-versioning policy and endpoint change history
- [Full documentation (llms-full.txt)](https://llm-prefill-decode-visualizer.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every agent-facing doc above compiled into one flat markdown file, served at `/llms-full.txt`

## Machine-readable surfaces

- [OpenAPI spec](https://llm-prefill-decode-visualizer.vercel.app/api/spec): derive every endpoint programmatically (identical under `/v1/spec`)
- [Agent manifest](https://llm-prefill-decode-visualizer.vercel.app/agents.json): machine-readable manifest of every agent-facing endpoint, generated from the route table
- [Agent endpoint index](https://llm-prefill-decode-visualizer.vercel.app/api/agent/index.json): complete per-endpoint index with request/response shape sketches (sibling of the agent manifest)
- [Compare slug manifest](public/compare-hardware-slugs.json): every measured hardware group's slug — join any two as `/compare/:slugA-vs-:slugB`; invalid pairs return HTTP 404
- [MCP server](mcp/server.js): Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC at `/api/mcp`; usage in the [MCP README](mcp/README.md)
- [Changelog feed](https://llm-prefill-decode-visualizer.vercel.app/changelog.json)
- [Status page](https://llm-prefill-decode-visualizer.vercel.app/status.html)

## Source map

- [Frontend app](src/App.jsx): React UI with nine tabs — single-turn, agentic loop, batching, compare, A/B replay, run diff, hardware shortlist, KV-cache calculator, theory
- [Standalone compare page](compare.html)
- [Serverless API](api/_router.js): all `/api/*` routes and handlers (compute simulators, vram fit, best/sizing recommendations, localmaxxing benchmarks, watch feeds, snapshots)
- [Shared math library](lib/)
- [Python client](clients/python/pyproject.toml)
- [TypeScript schema types](clients/typescript/schema.d.ts)
- [Build & codegen scripts](scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs)

## Typical agent workflow

1. Read [the full API guide](https://llm-prefill-decode-visualizer.vercel.app/llms.txt) once — it documents batching, dry-run validation, snapshot pinning and the `/v1/` prefix policy.
2. `GET /api/spec`, then call `/api/vram?hfId=…&context=…&vramGb=…` for fit checks or `/api/sizing?model=…` for ranked hardware recommendations.
3. Model request shapes with `GET|POST /api/compute?model=singleTurn|agentic|kvCache|cost|…`.
